changes.change: TESTING.md is now generated by `pubkit doc-coverage` (pubkit 0.6.0) instead of tools/doc-coverage.py; only its header line changed
Update other crates the supply-chain audits cover
SUPPLY-CHAIN.md names pubunit among the organisations whose audits are imported, since the workspace now imports pubunit's
sha2 0.11 replaces sha2 0.10, so block-buffer 0.10.4 (GHSA-qwgh-2vcv-g2f7) is no longer in publet-algorithms' dependency tree; the Merkle log's hashes are unchanged, and the MSRV stays 1.85
Documentation: SECURITY.md says cargo deny, cargo vet and OSV-Scanner also run every night (it said advisory checks ran only when code changed), and names pubunit among the imported audit sets

The h3 module: H3 cell identifiers, validated as H3 does (mode, reserved bits, base cell, digits, and pentagons' deleted direction), with each cell's parent at a coarser resolution and whether one cell is inside another by identifier, without geometry or floating point; tested against vectors from h3-py 4.5.0
Documentation: examples show their setup, and the docs state what panics, saturates, fails and costs (audit/publet-algorithms-0.2.2.md)

One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
